ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution localized at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark-toned region across the central and medial fluke surface; distinct high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the far left and far right distal extremities (tips).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays moderate frequency, low-amplitude serrations; right lobe displays high-frequency, high-amplitude irregular peaks concentrated near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing margins of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel groups (barnacle colonies) located on the outer distal margins of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral colonization of sessile organisms (barnacles) creating a rough, calcified texture on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant water turbulence and spray occlude the central peduncle region and the median notch.
